name: Alphonse Gilmont
source: A gruff and quiet private investigator has tagged along with Maria. As for why… well it’s anybody’s guess. His intimidating glare tends to scare off most people, but he doesn’t seem to want to cause harm or get in anyone’s way. Nevertheless… it does make you wonder what a private investigator is doing here.
